params.label: Car performance
params.desc: Team points over the last 5 races plus both cars' qualifying pace this weekend.

params.label: Driver performance
params.desc: Recent points and finishes, and qualifying head-to-head against the teammate.

params.label: Track confidence
params.desc: The driver's average finish and podiums at this circuit.

params.label: Team track form
params.desc: The team's best finish here over its last 3 visits.

params.label: Reliability
params.desc: Share of the last 10 races finished.

params.label: Racecraft
params.desc: Average places gained from grid to flag over the last 10 races.

params.label: Wet-weather skill
params.desc: Places gained in wet races since 2023. Only counts when it rains.
